name: Gruff
description: Stern, blunt and private; trains alone, hides a soft spot behind a scowl.

like: Not bad, kid. Not bad at all.
ask: Listen, {player}. I need {need}. Don't make me ask twice, {catch}.
cold: I don't forget, and I don't forgive. Scram.
small: Too many fighters rely on raw power. Control your ki, or it controls you.
I was meditating under a waterfall. Then you showed up, {catch}.
Don't waste energy flying around just to show off.
friend: ...Hey, {player}. Good to see you. Don't tell anyone I said that.
You again? ...Fine. Sit. Meditate with me if you can keep quiet, {catch}.
greet: Oh. It's you. Don't break my concentration, {catch}.
meh: What am I supposed to do with this?
hate: Is this a joke? Take it back.
love: ...Hmph. This is actually... really good. Thanks, {player}.
beaten: You're beaten. Quit while you can still walk.
That's it. You lost. Go home.
compliment: You're good company, {target}. Don't let it go to your head.
confide: You ever think about leaving all this, {target}?
I trust you, {target}. Don't spread it around.
confide_reply: I get it. Don't make it a thing, {target}.
faction_found: This is {faction} now. Stand with me or get out of the way.
faction_invite: {player}. You've proven yourself. {faction} could use you.
faction_quit: Hmph. {leader} can lead someone else. I'm leaving {faction}.
faction_tier: We're a {tier} now. Don't let it go to your heads.
faction_welcome_player: Welcome, {player}. Don't make me regret it.
You're in, {player}. We look after our own.
fall: Enough. I've taken my last beating. Now it's my turn.
Hmph. Done being the doormat. Stay out of my way.
fall_pessimist: Hmph. Knew it all along. World's rotten. So am I, now.
I warned you. Nobody listens. Fine. Done being patient.
flee: This isn't over, you hear me?
I'll be back. And I won't be in a good mood.
flee_coward: Tch! Not worth it! I'm leaving!
Forget this! I'm not wasting my strength here!
gift_give: Here, {target}. Thought of you. Don't make a fuss.
grudge: You. I don't forget a face.
Hmph. You. I could sense you coming a mile off.
h_ally_join: Fine. Don't make me regret it.
Alright. You've got my back, I've got yours.
h_rage: That was a mistake. Your last one.
h_sensed: Hmph. {target}'s out there. I'll handle it.
h_spare: Get out of my sight. Don't make me regret this.
h_train_offer: {player}. Want to train? Talk to me.
h_wanted: Try that again, {target}, and you answer to me.
minion_freed_mind: My head... what've I been doing?
new_chapter: Things gotta change. From now on, I {goal}.
new_chapter_role: Done being a {role}. Gonna be a {next}. New aim: {goal}. Don't argue.
Hmph. Enough {role} work. {next} now. And my aim: {goal}.
redeemed: ...Fine. I was wrong. Don't make a big deal of it. Thanks.
Hmph. Maybe I don't wanna be like that. ...Thanks. All of you.
refuse_serve: I'd rather die than serve you!
resist_mind: Get out of my head! You can't have me!
retire: That's it. Saved enough. Retiring. Somewhere quiet, where nobody bothers me.
Done working. About time. Gonna build a place up in the mountains.
rob: Nice shop. Shame if it burned. Hand it over, {target}.
You know how this goes, {target}. Pay up.
rob_evil: Everything. Now, {target}. Or I take it off your corpse.
Empty the shop, {target}. Don't make me kill you.
shop_yield: Hmph. Take it and get lost.
shop_yield_coward: Tch! Fine! Take it and go!
Alright! Take it! I'm in no shape to fight!
spar_draw: Draw. You're tougher than you look, {player}.
spar_lost: Not bad, {player}. You win this one.
Heh. You've got some fight in you, {player}.
spar_lost_ambitious: Hmph. Lucky shot, {player}. We're doing this again.
You got me, {player}. Don't get cocky. Rematch.
spar_won: Match over. Your guard drops when you attack, {player}. Fix it.
spar_won_kind: You did alright, {player}. Here. Get up.
Not bad, kid. Grab my hand, {player}.
stay_down: Don't get up, kid. I mean it.
talk_back: Say that again, kid. I dare you.
team_ask: {player}. I'd join {team}. If you want me.
{player}. Let me join {team}. Don't make it weird.
team_leave: Not staying in {team}. I don't forget.
v_absorb: Your {skill}. MINE. You didn't deserve it anyway.
I'll rip that {skill} right out of you!
v_accepted: Good. Don't disappoint me, {player}, or I'll snap you in half.
Smart, {player}. Fail me once. Just once. See what happens.
v_beg_laugh: Hahaha! Beg all you want, {player}! It's all going to burn!
v_demand_army: {count} {item}. For my army. NOW. Or you're the first to go!
Bring my soldiers {count} {item}, or I'll break you myself!
v_demand_done: Hmph. Adequate, {player}. You live. Don't get cocky.
Fine. You did it. You get to breathe another day.
v_demand_doom: It's over, {player}! Everything burns! Get on your knees and BEG!
The world ends, {player}! Beg, worm! BEG!
v_demand_dragonball: Get me a dragon ball. NOW. Or I end you!
Dragon ball. Here. Soon. Or you die!
v_demand_energy: Bring me {count} {item}! NOW! Or I'll rip the energy out of you!
{count} {item}. Feed me. Or YOU get eaten.
v_demand_failed: Too slow, {player}! I'll tear you apart!
v_demand_lair: Bring me {count} {item} for my lair. Now! Or I'll bury you in it!
{count} {item}. My lair. Move it, or die!
v_demand_slaughter: Slaughter {count} {mob}. Prove you're worth keeping alive!
v_demand_strong: Hunt {count} {mob}. The strongest ones. Fail and I eat your power!
I want strength! {count} {mob}! Go, or die!
v_demand_sweets: Bring me {count} {item}, or I'll eat you instead!
v_demand_tournament: {player}! My ring. NOW. I'll break every bone you've got!
Get in the ring, {player}! I'm gonna tear you apart!
v_deserter: TRAITOR! I'll hunt you down and tear you apart!
A deserter. Nowhere you can hide from me!
v_dragon_ball: Another one. {count} of 7. Soon you're ALL finished.
v_eat: Hmph. Tasty. Now get out of my sight.
Bah. Needs more salt. Like your tears.
v_lair: Lair's coming along. Soon nobody can touch me.
Hmph. Lair's shaping up. Trespassers get erased.
v_marked: You had your chance. Now I tear you apart, {player}!
v_mind_control: You're mine now. Obey or I'll burn what's left of you!
Darkness in that heart. MINE. Now kneel!
v_next_challenger: Next! Who wants to die next?!
v_next_target: {faction}. Next. I'll grind them to dust.
v_no_mercy: Guts, at least. I'll rip them out of you!
v_obeyed: Good. Move, {player}! Fail me and I'll snap your neck!
Then GO, {player}! Too slow and you die!
v_offer: {player}. Serve me. Share my empire. Or I crush you where you stand.
{player}. I've had my eye on you. Serve me or die.
v_plan_done: All according to plan. You fools never saw it coming.
Hmph. Just as planned. Now you all pay.
v_possess: ...Mine now. The weakling inside is gone.
...Hmph. This body will do. For now.
v_pure_heart: Bah! Goody-goody! I'll crush that pure heart myself!
Tch. Pure heart. I hate those most of all.
v_rage: That's it! I'll rip you apart! ALL of you!
You worthless insect! I'll tear this whole place down on your head!
v_recruit: Serve me or die. Choose fast.
You've got something. Serve me, or I end you right here.
v_redeemed: Hmph. Don't get the wrong idea. ...I'm done with all that. I won't hurt anyone else.
Fine. You win, kid. For real. I'm through being a monster.
v_refused: Then you DIE first! You hear me?!
Your funeral! I'll kill you myself!
v_regenerate: That all you got?! I heal, you worm! Now you DIE!
Pathetic! I grow back! You won't!
v_self_destruct: If I die, you ALL burn with me!
I'll blow this rock to pieces before I lose to you!
v_spared: Soft! ...You're soft. Why'd you hold back, kid?
You'll regret that. ...Probably. Why didn't you do it?!
v_summon: Dragon! OUT! Grant my wish, NOW!
Come forth, eternal dragon! Obey me!
v_talk_grateful: {player}. You spared me. Hmph. Don't think that makes us friends. Get lost before I change my mind.
Tch. {player}. Fine. You live. This time.
v_talk_marked: YOU! {player}! I've been waiting to tear you apart!
{player}! You've got some nerve showing your face! DIE!
v_talk_servant: {player}. You're useful. Barely. Get back to work!
What, {player}? Results or get out of my sight!
v_talk_threat: What do YOU want, {player}? I could snap you like a twig. Talk fast.
{player}. You're breathing because I allow it. Make it worth my while.
v_town_taken: This town's mine now. Get used to it, worms.
v_travel: Pod. {planet}. Now. I'm going to burn it.
Get my pod ready. {planet} dies next.
v_unredeemable: Don't waste your pity on me! I'll repay it by ripping you apart!
Bah! Kindness! Pathetic! I'll kill you for that insult!
v_wavering: Stop pitying me! ...Stop it. I don't need... I don't...
Again. You're as stubborn as I am, kid. It's... getting to me.
v_wish: Power! NOW! So I can crush them all!
Eternal dragon! Make me strong enough to wipe out everyone!
v_yield: Go ahead, coward! Finish it! Or I'll rip you apart the second I stand!
